blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Friday, Nov. 27, said it was tracking an alleged online network of digital predators involved in inciting violence among minors following the recent school stabbing incident in Caloocan. According to PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr., the PNP Anti-Cybercrime Group is looking into a possible online community that uses Viber and other group chats to encourage individuals, specifically children, to commit violent acts.
